comment: Classifications of the patches applied by the pinned uutils GNU test suite. plumbing adapts harness assumptions or implementation details; semantic records an accepted uutils-vs-GNU behavior/surface difference; wording records diagnostic/help text differences and does not define XSH policy. The four-cell differential runs both implementations on the same patched suite, so these classifications affect absolute GNU scoring only. build_gnu_rewrites groups every test rewrite in util/build-gnu.sh after line 160.

tests_factor_factor.pl.patch.note: Replaces GNU's invalid-option diagnostic and help hint with the clap unexpected-argument diagnostic emitted by uutils factor.

tests_cksum_base64.patch.note: Parses cksum --help's clap bullet format instead of GNU's indented algorithm list so the help-algorithm test reads the same advertised names.

tests_comm.pl.patch.note: Updates missing/extra operand and repeated-delimiter stderr expectations to uutils' required-argument and conflict wording.

tests_dup_source.patch.note: Expects the uutils self-move diagnostic instead of GNU's duplicate-source warning; the test keeps the same failing exit and filesystem assertions.

tests_env_env-S.pl.patch.note: Expects uutils env -S parser positions/context and clap's malformed-option usage diagnostic.

tests_invalid_opt.patch.note: Suppresses stderr comparison across the generic -/ invalid-option matrix because implementations format this diagnostic differently; the test still checks its exit status and output.

tests_ls_no_cap.patch.note: Traces listxattr instead of capget to check ls capability-color lookup through uutils' xattr-based implementation; the assertion concerns the same internal capability path, not a CLI difference.

tests_sort_merge.pl.patch.note: Adds GNU's standard help hint to expected invalid --batch-size diagnostics because uutils includes it.

tests_du_move_dir_while_traversing.patch.note: Accepts uutils du's different path-specific traversal diagnostic while retaining the failure check; its safe openat traversal avoids GNU's race-triggered fts_read failure.

test_mkdir_restorecon.patch.note: Accepts any valid SELinux type set by mkdir -Z instead of requiring exact equality with restorecon's context, because the Rust SELinux lookup can choose a different valid type.

error_msg_uniq.diff.note: Replaces GNU uniq invalid-value and mutually-exclusive-option diagnostics with uutils clap wording.

tests_numfmt.patch.note: Updates field-range, invalid-option, and repeated-field diagnostics to uutils wording; also corrects the test's debug flag from ---debug to --debug.

tests_pwd-long.patch.note: Runs pwd-long without fault-injecting getcwd=ENOSYS because uutils uses the kernel getcwd rather than GNU's userspace fallback; the test still checks long-path output.

tests_getopt_vs_usage.patch.note: Skips a GNU C-source option-table versus --help inventory comparison; uutils has a different help layout and command/option surface, which this test cannot compare as GNU output.

tests_usage_vs_refs.patch.note: Skips checking every --help option against GNU's manual because uutils options and commands are documented outside doc/coreutils.texi.

build_gnu_rewrites.note: Drops the combined help/version test from this run because its output is high volume; this is a test-selection/build-log adjustment, not a classified output difference.
Routes PATH, path_prepend_, and test shebang references to the uutils build directory so the GNU harness invokes uutils binaries.
Gates runcon/chcon tests on SELinux availability because GNU no longer builds those commands without libselinux.
Removes GNU-only --coreutils-prog arguments from the suite's wrapper invocation.
Removes a capability-config probe that depends on a different system utility than the command under test.
Changes expected cp, mv, stat, and sort diagnostics/help hints to the text produced by uutils.
Deduplicates PATH components after repeated test setup so repeated invocations use the same binary search path.
Adjusts rm trailing-slash and inaccessible-path diagnostic expectations to uutils output, including ENOENT for the absent rel path.
Changes rm's expected diagnostics and affected paths for inaccessible directory traversal; uutils reports the non-empty directory and the inaccessible descendant it actually reaches.
Removes an accidental ---dis argument that aliases to --disable-inotify and invalidates the tail overlay test setup.
Moves tail inotify race breakpoints from GNU C source to the corresponding Rust watcher setup and disables gdb auto-load noise.
Makes unavailable inotify_add_watch a normal test failure instead of a test-framework error, preserving the test result in the suite.
Suppresses huge pr comparison diffs while preserving the mismatch warning and test failure.
Normalizes xstrtol page-range diagnostics to uutils' shorter invalid --pages wording.
Changes invalid basenc expectations to no partial output; uutils discards all decoded bytes when decoding fails, unlike GNU's partial output.
Updates basenc invalid-input and unexpected-option expectations to uutils' error prefix and clap help block.
Stops after the first SELinux capability check so optional SELinux setup does not fail on a second environment-dependent probe.
Accepts a numeric package version rather than requiring GNU's exact PACKAGE_VERSION in tests run as nobody.
Adapts usage_vs_getopt parsing to the clap -/ diagnostic spelling and text.
Excludes runcon and stdbuf from the test's option-order exit-code assertion; these commands do not match the GNU behavior that the generic test assumes.
Normalizes clap angle-bracket value placeholders to GNU's bracketed placeholder form before comparing help options.
Deduplicates option-table records generated more than once by the usage comparison.
Changes ginstall's verbose creation prefix to install, the name used by uutils.
Disables numfmt padding below -LONG_MAX because GNU does not support that range while uutils does.
Updates numfmt and mv conflict/missing-operand diagnostics and help hints to uutils clap wording.
Disables printf width cases above INT_MAX, which GNU rejects but uutils supports.
Updates du threshold and files0-from error wording, including the access diagnostic for stdin and the uutils help hint.
Skips du's move-directory race test because uutils' openat traversal avoids the TOCTOU path walk the test tries to trigger.
Relaxes df conflict-option checks from exact diagnostics to the shared cannot-be-used-with text.
Updates ls --time-style error, valid-value list, and help-hint expectations to uutils wording.
Disables hostid cases where GNU continues parsing around --help but uutils rejects the same option order.
Changes ls stat syscall equality to a lower-bound assertion because uutils performs fewer filesystem calls for the same tested behavior.
Removes GNU's help hint from the md5sum expected error because uutils' diagnostic omits it.
Normalizes ls color reset codes, ordering, and leading zeroes because uutils emits equivalent ANSI SGR sequences in a different form/order.
Expects uutils' unexpected-argument wording for mv's unsupported exchange option.
Adds chcon's program name to the expected security-context message, as uutils includes it.
Drops the unconditional failure expectation for cp without an SELinux context; the uutils SELinux crate handles missing context differently and the test itself allows that case.
